pricing.a: Every space is different, so pricing depends on size, condition and how often you book. Standard home cleans start around $120 and deep cleans around $200. Your quote is always free and tailored — no surprises.

eco.q: Are your products eco-friendly and safe for pets and kids?
eco.a: Yes. We use eco-friendly, low-odor products that are tough on dirt but gentle on your family, pets and indoor air. If you have specific sensitivities, just let us know.

supplies.q: Do I need to provide supplies or equipment?
supplies.a: No — our team arrives fully equipped with professional, eco-friendly supplies. If you'd prefer we use a specific product you already own, we're happy to.

pets.q: What should I do with my pets during the cleaning?
pets.a: Pets are welcome to stay home. Just tell us about them when you book so our team can plan accordingly and keep them comfortable and safe.

satisfaction.q: What if I'm not happy with the cleaning?
satisfaction.a: Your satisfaction is guaranteed. If anything isn't right, let us know within 24 hours and we'll return to re-clean it free of charge.

bilingual.q: Do you offer service in Spanish?
bilingual.a: Absolutely. Limpios is fully bilingual — we're glad to help you in English or Spanish, by phone, message or in person.

insured.a: Yes. Limpios is licensed and insured, and our team is vetted and background-checked for your peace of mind.

booking.q: How do I book or get a quote?
booking.a: Request a free quote online in about two minutes, or call us directly. We'll confirm the details and schedule a time that works for you.
